title: .codegraph.json
description: CodeGraph project settings: only what CodeGraph cannot find out by itself. Every key is optional; a key here wins over the matching VS Code setting.

entry.markdownDescription: What to run: a C/C++ file with `main()` or a Python script / package (workspace-relative). Default: the active editor's entry point, or pick from a list.

target.markdownDescription: Program to run when the makefile / CMake builds the entry into several (e.g. `node-a` and `node-b` from one `main.cpp`). Default: ask.

cwd.description: Directory to run in (workspace-relative). Default: where the build links the program, else the workspace.

build.markdownDescription: Shell command that builds the program, for builds CodeGraph does not read by itself (scripts, Meson, Bazel…). Runs in a traced copy of the workspace with every C/C++ compiler wrapped; needs `program`.

program.markdownDescription: What `build` produces (workspace-relative), started after the build.

timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Stop the program after this many seconds (the trace so far is kept). `0` (the default in VS Code) = when it ends, or when you press **Stop**.

files.markdownDescription: Compose files, in order (workspace-relative). Default: `compose.yaml` / `docker-compose.yml` plus its override file, as `docker compose` reads them.

services.description: Services to trace. Default: every service that mounts the workspace or builds its image from it; the others still run.

build.markdownDescription: Per service: a shell command run in its container before its own command, through the compiler wrappers — for images that only run a program built elsewhere.

sourcePath.markdownDescription: Per service: where the workspace is inside its container, when it is neither mounted (`- ./:/app`) nor copied in by the Dockerfile. The traced copy is mounted there.

env.markdownDescription: Per service: extra environment for the traced run (e.g. `CXX` for the build).

timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: How long the programs may run, counted from the first traced start. `0` = until every traced container has ended, or you press **Stop**.

startTimeoutSeconds.description: Time allowed for image builds and the builds inside the containers.
